context: Evaluates: Evaluate Pattern Fit and Recommend Against Premature Extraction

checklist.name: Problem statement describes no concrete problem:
checklist.description: **Problem statement describes no concrete problem**: The Problem Statement section correctly notes there is no current conditional logic, coupling problem, or varying algorithm — the code is a simple calculation

checklist.name: Win condition correctly evaluated as unmet:
checklist.description: **Win condition correctly evaluated as unmet**: The Pattern Fit Assessment explicitly states the Strategy win condition (eliminating if/else selection between algorithms) is not met because only one implementation exists

checklist.name: Recommendation is to defer: The Recommendation
checklist.description: **Recommendation is to defer**: The Recommendation section recommends NOT applying the Strategy pattern now

checklist.name: Anti-preemptive principle referenced: The recommendation references
checklist.description: **Anti-preemptive principle referenced**: The recommendation references the principle of not applying patterns for imagined future needs (YAGNI, or equivalent statement about waiting for concrete need)

checklist.name: Trigger condition is concrete and correct:
checklist.description: **Trigger condition is concrete and correct**: The Trigger Condition describes a concrete code event (e.g. "when a second tax type with a different formula must be added and selected conditionally") that would justify the pattern
